theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (J h : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞) (A : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ U → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEMeasurable h ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → AEMeasurable J ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → (∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A)), J (Φ w) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det)) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, h x * J x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : Eucl P // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
